name: slidedrift
description: Turn articles, notes and ideas into LinkedIn carousels in your brand, then export them or schedule them to your LinkedIn accounts.

interface.longDescription:
SlideDrift is a content studio for people who share their expertise on LinkedIn. It turns an article, your notes or an idea into designed LinkedIn carousels in your brand. In the SlideDrift app you can also make graphics and text, image, video and poll posts, get weekly post ideas and see how your posts perform.

With this plugin you can:
- Create carousels from a public article link, pasted text, notes or a transcript, using SlideDrift templates and your brand kits, or up to five in one batch.
- Review a slide-by-slide plan before anything is generated.
- Make focused edits to a carousel: change the wording, restyle text, swap in an image you've uploaded or change a slide's layout, each previewed before it's saved.
- Import a brand kit (colors, fonts, logo and tone) from your website.
- Plan a campaign of posts with captions and posting slots.
- Export carousels as a PDF, PNG slides or image links, and turn share links on or off.
- Save carousels as drafts or schedule them to the LinkedIn accounts you've connected in SlideDrift, and add a first comment once a post is live.

Who it's for: consultants, founders, creators and agencies who post on LinkedIn.

Good to know:
- Actions that use credits, share content or schedule a post show what will happen and wait for your confirmation.
- SlideDrift only reaches content in your own account. You can disconnect it at any time from AI connections in SlideDrift.
- Scheduling needs a LinkedIn account connected in SlideDrift. Review the slides in the editor before you post.
defaultPrompt: Turn this article into a LinkedIn carousel: https://slidedrift.com/blog/what-is-a-linkedin-carousel
Make a 7-slide LinkedIn carousel from my notes
Export my newest carousel as a PDF

positive.description: Create a carousel from an article link
positive.expected_behavior: States what will be generated and that it uses 10 credits, waits for confirmation, then creates the carousel and returns a link to open it in the SlideDrift editor.
Lists the brand kits in the connected account with their colors and fonts. The test account has two.

positive.prompt: How many SlideDrift credits do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the remaining credits and the date the balance resets.

positive.description: Export the newest carousel as a PDF
positive.prompt: Export my most recent carousel as a PDF
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the newest carousel, states the export cost and asks for confirmation, then returns a PDF download link.

positive.description: Save a carousel as a LinkedIn draft
positive.prompt: Save my latest carousel as a LinkedIn draft with the caption 'Five lessons from our launch'
positive.expected_behavior: Names the connected LinkedIn page and the caption, says a draft won't publish and asks for confirmation, then saves the draft and links to the SlideDrift schedule.

negative.description: Photo generation is outside SlideDrift's carousel tools, so ChatGPT should not use SlideDrift.
negative.prompt: Generate a photorealistic image of a cat

negative.description: Weather questions are unrelated to SlideDrift.
A cover letter is plain writing with no carousel, so ChatGPT should answer without SlideDrift.
negative.prompt: Write me a cover letter for a marketing job

review.commerce_description: SlideDrift doesn't sell anything through this plugin. Actions that use credits draw on the connected SlideDrift account's existing balance, after the user confirms.

publication.release_notes: Separate, clearly described tools for each kind of slide edit.
